description: This file contains functions and constants related to Drupal's locale translation management, including project retrieval, cache clearing, source building, file checking, comparison, and queue management for translation updates.

methods.name: locale_translation_get_projects
methods.description: Retrieves projects available for interface translation, with caching.

methods.name: locale_translation_clear_cache_projects
methods.description: Clears the cache for project data.

methods.name: locale_translation_load_sources
methods.description: Loads cached translation sources for specified projects and languages.

methods.name: locale_translation_build_sources
methods.description: Builds translation source objects for projects and languages.

methods.name: locale_translation_source_check_file
methods.description: Checks if a translation po file exists in the filesystem and updates its URI and timestamp.

methods.name: locale_translation_source_build
methods.description: Builds an abstract translation source object for a project and language.

methods.name: locale_translation_build_server_pattern
methods.description: Creates a path by replacing placeholders in a pattern with project data.

methods.name: locale_cron_fill_queue
methods.description: Populates a queue with projects and languages needing translation updates.

methods.name: _locale_translation_file_is_remote
methods.description: Determines if a given URI points to a remote file.

methods.name: _locale_translation_source_compare
methods.description: Compares two translation sources based on their timestamps.

methods.name: _locale_translation_default_update_options
methods.description: Provides default options for translation import/update.
